newsitem.title: USA: Hoechst Celanese inspects damage at Texas plant.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst Celanese inspects damage at Texas plant.

text.p: Hoechst Celanese Corp expects a methanol unit involved in an explosion at its Clear Lake, Texas plant early Tuesday to be idled for several weeks for repairs, a plant spokesman said.
"It's certainly going to be a matter of weeks" before the unit is back in service, the spokesman said.
Exterior panels were blown off the world-class, 4 million pound a day unit in the explosion, but there was no fire and crews are assessing damage to the unit's working parts, he said.
The 0700 CST explosion could be felt several miles away but there were no injuries in the explosion, which occured a day after the unit was taken down for planned maintenance.
The unit is operated in a joint venture with Valero Energy Corp to produce methyl tertiary butyl ether, a gasoline additive.
Hoechst Celanese is a unit of Hoechst AG
